pages.text: Soul Jars are used in combination with a $(l:souls/soulium_dagger)Soulium Dagger$() to collect mob souls. Filled Soul Jars can be used to create $(l:basics/resource_crops)Resource Crops$() for the corresponding entity. $(br2)Soul Jars can also be filled using mob drops with a $(l:machines/soul_extractor)Soul Extractor$().
